messages:
Lee: Heads-up — I clicked the runtime guide TOC and the 'Batching' link jumps to a 404 on prod docs. Looks like the header text changed in the last docs PR and the anchor id wasn't updated. Failing URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#batching. Can someone take ownership for a quick patch?

LinkCheckBot: LinkCheckBot report: 1 broken anchor in /runtime/quickstart -> '/runtime/quickstart#batching' returns 404. Report ID: LCB-2026-1765. Suggest either update TOC anchor or add an explicit anchor in the target section.

Maria: I can take this. Quick question — do we prefer a redirect (short-term) or update the TOC to match the new header?

Lee: @Maria thanks — I'd prefer updating the TOC to match the canonical section header (it now reads 'Batching basics'). Quick local fix I tested:

```
# replace the old fragment in the TOC file
git checkout -b docs/fix/toc-batching-1765012345
sed -i "s/#batching/#batching-basics/g" docs/runtime/quickstart.md
git add docs/runtime/quickstart.md && git commit -m "docs: fix TOC anchor -> batching-basics"
```

Branch name suggestion: docs/fix/toc-batching-1765012345. I'll leave the exact commit message to you.

Chris: I can review and add a tiny CI guard. We should add a linkcheck step for TOC anchors in docs CI to prevent repeats. I'll add a small workflow tweak in .github/workflows/docs.yml that runs the linkcheck only for changed runtime pages.

Maria: Pushed branch and opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024. Diff is one-line change to docs/runtime/quickstart.md: -[old anchor link] +[#batching-basics]. Please review @Chris @Lee. CC @Ivy for i18n — if the header text changed in English, localized pages might need updates too.

Ivy: Thanks for the ping — I'll grep ja/ and zh/ targets after the English PR merges. If localized headings differ, I'll follow up with a small localization PR.

Chris: I'll add the CI change in a follow-up commit on this branch (or separate PR) — plan: add a lightweight linkcheck job that runs `linkcheck --anchors` for runtime/*.md. Quick note: keep the job cached and fast so it doesn't slow down every PR. :thumbsup:

Maria: PR updated with the sed change and a brief notes block in the PR description explaining the cause (header rename). Ready for review — marking as small and high-priority.

Lee: LGTM once CI passes. After merge, let's run a one-off linkcheck sweep across the entire runtime section to catch any other drift and create redirects for older external shortlinks if needed. Thanks for the quick ownership @Maria.

LinkCheckBot: LinkCheckBot scheduled re-scan for /runtime at 2026-03-02T12:05:00Z post-merge.
